instruction.text: Drag the germs into the water.

feedback.finish: Harmful bacteria and viruses can be found in contaminated drinking water. In the UK, water is treated so that our tap water is safe to drink.

instruction.text: Select the two animals that are most likely to transmit diseases to humans.

feedback.correct1: As dogs live in many of our homes, we can catch some of the illnesses that they might get.
feedback.correct2: Mosquitoes are the deadliest animal in the world! They transmit diseases like malaria, which kills hundreds of thousands of people every year.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Bacteria and viruses can be transmitted from human to human through droplets in the air that are released when people sneeze, cough and breathe. If they get into another person’s body, it can make them ill too. This is a common way for diseases to spread.
It is also very easy to come into contact with bacteria and viruses on surfaces like door handles, which is why good hygiene practices are important.
If we regularly wash our hands with soap and water and cover our coughs and sneezes, diseases are less likely to be transmitted from person to person.

atoms.a: What transmits germs from human to human?
Which actions help to spread germs?
How can we reduce the spread of germs?

instruction.text: Select all foods that should not be eaten.

feedback.finish: Bacteria and viruses can also be passed on through mouldy or badly prepared food. This is called food poisoning. One of the most common food-related bacteria is salmonella, which is often found in chicken and eggs.

atoms.b: Bacterial and viral diseases have to be treated ((++differently in_the_same_way)).
Bacterial diseases can be treated with ((++medication refrigeration)) called antibiotics.
Some antibiotics ((++kill help)) the different bacteria in the body, and others just stop them from ((++multiplying dividing)).

Taking antibiotics can also have negative side effects. They don’t just damage the bad bacteria in the body, they also damage good ((++bacteria viruses)). Therefore, it is very important to only take antibiotics when a ((++doctor family_member)) tells you to.

instruction.text: Select the syringe to learn about treating viruses.

finish.text:
We can prevent viruses using vaccines, a special type of medicine that contains a weakened virus. Your body can easily deal with this virus and builds up immunity for the future!

We can also treat infections with medication called antivirals.
